game.name: Super Off Road
game.desc: Ivan 'Ironman' Stewart's Super Off Road: four trucks race around eight dirt tracks seen from above, over jumps, bumps and water, forwards and reversed. Pick up nitro and cash on the track, then spend the winnings in the Speed Shop on nitro, tires, shocks, acceleration and top speed before the next race. The best drivers join the Ironman Club. Up to three players. This port rebuilds the 1990 DOS version from the DOS program's own logic.
